2026So Far: The Foreman Pulls Two Games ClearIn progress · 8 weeks in · dahlilama 13-3, Birdgangflyeagles 11-5, Goldminers1 10-6

Eight weeks in, dahlilama dropped the week's top score, went 2-0 while Birdgangflyeagles went 0-2, and now leads the league by two games and in points. Behind him, the middle of the table got crowded. The evidence so far.

13-3dahlilama, two games clear

1,037points for dahlilama, league lead
209transactions so far

A two-game cushion

dahlilama beat MayockJr 151.40–116.62 with the top score of the week, his third straight head-to-head win. He's 13-3, two games ahead of Birdgangflyeagles, and he passed Goldminers1 for the league lead in points (1,037 to 1,006). That was his eighth weekly high score since 2023, tying rbanuelos3 for the most in league history. He's still the futures favorite at +150.

Birdgangflyeagles skids

Sleon1000 beat Birdgangflyeagles 109.10–94.26. That's two straight head-to-head losses for Birdgangflyeagles after his 6-0 start, and 94.26 was below the week's median, so it was another 0-2 week. He's 11-5, still second, and still has the second-fewest points against (768).

For Sleon1000 it's three straight head-to-head wins after an 0-5 start, and he's 7-9. His 109.10 was just under the median, so it counted as a lucky win, his ninth all-time and the most in the league.

Traffic jam at 10-6 and 9-7

Goldminers1 beat giJ03 111.40–79.50 and elysianbeer beat showmeyourtd23 117.28–106.08. Both scored above the median, both went 2-0, and both are 10-6. elysianbeer has won two straight head-to-head.

One game back, juleon8 beat Bjspjs4 114.66–94.00 and kevinnguu beat rbanuelos3 113.06–107.88. Both went 2-0 and are 9-7. juleon8 still has the fewest points against in the league (740) and is second in the futures market at +950, level with Birdgangflyeagles.

Bjspjs4 makes it seven

Bjspjs4 traded Tyler Allgeier to kevinnguu for TreVeyon Henderson. That's his seventh trade of 2026, matching his total from all of last season. Then he lost to juleon8 below the median and is 7-9. Both of kevinnguu's trades this year have been with Bjspjs4; he got Dameon Pierce from him in Week 6.

Also in the file

  • MayockJr scored 116.62, third-best of the week, and still lost. He split the week and is 6-10. He leads the league with 39 moves.
  • rbanuelos3 has lost four straight head-to-head and is 6-10.
  • giJ03 had the week's low score, 79.50, his fourth straight head-to-head loss. He's 4-12.
  • showmeyourtd23 is also 4-12 and has gone 2-6 head-to-head.

cases.dahlilama: 2023 champ, 2025 runner-up and Points King, 4-1 all-time in the playoffs. 13-3, two games clear, and now leads the league in points.
cases.juleon8: Owns the league-record 11-game head-to-head win streak, snapped by 1.82 points in Week 4. Went from 1-5 to the 3 seed last year.
cases.Birdgangflyeagles: 11-5. His 6-0 head-to-head start has turned into two straight losses. Has been a 1 seed and a last-place team. No middle gear.
cases.Sleon1000: Best all-time record (26-16) and two straight #1 seeds, but 0-2 in the playoffs. 7-9 this year after three straight head-to-head wins.
cases.rbanuelos3: Owns the season points record (1,858) and the highest score ever (180.24). Two playoff trips, no ring, and 6-10 after four straight head-to-head losses.
cases.kevinnguu: Rookie. 122.86 in his debut, and his first head-to-head win came against the futures favorite.
cases.elysianbeer: Dropped 152.58 in Week 4, the top score of that week. 10-6 after two straight head-to-head wins. Still paying off last October's trade.
cases.Goldminers1: Four seasons, no playoff trips yet, and a league-record 10 weekly low scores. Also second in the league in points after a 175.08 and a 144.32.
cases.MayockJr: The league's busiest manager. 61 moves last year turned a 7-7 team into a third-place finish.
cases.giJ03: Rookie, 4-12, and his Week 2 55.74 is already on the all-time low-score list. The field.
cases.showmeyourtd23: Reached the first title game without making a trade. Hasn't made the playoffs since.
cases.Bjspjs4: 7-9 with seven trades already, drafting from slot 8, the slot that's won all three titles. The 17-25 career mark is why the number's this long.
